purpose: Adds an off-chain 'AutomatedCycleService' (durable lease + budget gate + policy-signed wallets + fee-settlement observer) that turns the existing durable CycleRunner journal into an unattended, restart-safe, one-pack-at-a-time cycle loop, plus a duplicate/independent on-chain fee-claim surface (claimProgrammable/claimTreasury/readFeeLiabilities placed in ProcessBudget.sol instead of HookemonHook.sol) and a Phase-2 Robinhood launch-evidence schema validator. Also adds a CycleRunner 'supersedeUnobservedIntent' mechanism (owner-signed, dual-observer-proven) to unstick a cycle whose external mutation was broadcast but never observed, and hardens feasibility/verify-robinhood-binding.mjs to require finalized-block RPC reads and an eth_getProof-derived runtime-code-hash match instead of silently accepting a missing proof.

files.role: Orchestrator: acquires exclusive lease, reads/creates a cycle via budget-gate decision, drives CycleRunner-equivalent stages [funding,outbound,purchase,open,buyback,return,distribution,payout] through an injected stageDriver (reconcile/execute/commit), heartbeat-renews the lease every ttl/2 ms, calls feeSettlementObserver.observe() after completion (failure there does not fail the cycle).

Pure function decideCycleBudget(input): parses canonical uint256 decimal strings, required = packPrice+outboundCap+returnCap+operatingMargin, returns ready only if activeCycleId is null AND available>=required; releaseAmount is always exactly `required`, never the full balance.

CAS-based durable lease (acquireLease/renewLease/releaseLease/assertLeaseCurrent) against an injected store with readLease/compareAndSwapLease; owner+token+version fencing prevents a stalled worker from committing after a replacement lease is acquired post-expiry.

planFeeSettlements(snapshot) builds fixed-destination PROGRAMMABLE/TREASURY claim plans (status PENDING_BENEFICIARY_AUTHORITY if not claimable, never fabricated as paid); verifyFeeSettlement(receipt, plan, evidence) requires an independently-fetched finalized chainReceipt AND a separate credit (before/after balance delta) evidence object bound to the same asset/source/destination/amount before accepting a receipt.

EvmPolicyWallet/SolanaPolicyWallet: exact-schema policy (allowedDestinations/Functions/Assets, maxAmount) binds every intent; sign() checkpoints signed bytes keyed by intent digest (idempotent replay-safe), broadcast() and reconcile() re-validate the checkpoint; rejects any config carrying privateKey/secretKey/mnemonic/seed/keypair fields.

A stuck (unresolved) external mutation can be superseded only with fresh dual-observer proof it was never observed AND a fresh owner-signed, nonce-unique authorization; the OLD attempt record is retained (not deleted) and a new signed-bytes digest is mandatory (reusing the old digest is rejected).

stateTransitions: AutomatedCycleService.#run: acquire lease -> (create cycle if budget ready, else return WAITING_FOR_PROCESS_BUDGET/ACTIVE_CYCLE_NOT_RECONCILED/LEASE_HELD/NO_ACTIVE_CYCLE) -> for each of 8 stages: read stage -> skip if COMPLETE -> prepareStage -> reconcile (may already have evidence) -> execute if evidence null -> reconcile again -> commit -> completeStage -> renew lease -> after all stages: completeCycle -> observe fee settlement (best-effort) -> COMPLETE.
Lease: none -> held(v1,ownerA) -> renewed(v2..vN, same owner+token) -> released(null) | replaced by a different owner once expired (version continues incrementing, old owner's fenced calls now fail).

External mutation (reducer.mjs): (none) -> 'unresolved' [external-mutation-attempted] -> either 'externally-reconciled' [external-mutation-reconciled] OR 'superseded' [external-mutation-superseded, requires dual-observer NOT_FOUND proof + owner authorization] -> the new request digest starts its own 'unresolved' attempt.

Policy wallet checkpoint: (none) -> SIGNED [sign()] -> BROADCAST [broadcast(), idempotent no-op if already BROADCAST] -> reconcile() reads independent observer evidence without mutating the checkpoint further.

phase2-launch-evidence: INTEGRATION_PENDING (all provider-bound fields null) <-non-reversible-in-schema-> READY_FOR_VERIFICATION (all fields finalized); the validator does not itself perform this transition, only accepts/rejects a caller-supplied evidence object in either state.

suspicions.note: claimProgrammable/claimTreasury/readFeeLiabilities added here DUPLICATE functions that main's current HookemonHook.sol (from the separately-merged codex/integrate-canonical-v4-hook branch) already defines directly on HookemonHook.sol itself. Since HookemonHook -> HolderSettlement -> PayoutCommitment -> ProcessBudget is main's real inheritance chain, merging this branch's ProcessBudget.sol onto current main while keeping main's HookemonHook.sol unchanged produces two definitions of the same external function signature in the inheritance chain -- a near-certain Solidity compile error, not a simple textual merge conflict. Confirmed by grepping main's ProcessBudget.sol (has neither function) and main's HookemonHook.sol (has both) plus main's PayoutCommitment.sol import chain.

`_transferUsdg` treats a call that succeeds with EMPTY return data as a successful transfer (`result.length != 0 && (result.length != 32 || !abi.decode(...))`); main's already-integrated HookemonHook.sol instead REQUIRES exactly 32 bytes decoding to true (`result.length != 32 || !abi.decode(...)`) and additionally checks `Currency.unwrap(config.usdg) != pegCycleUsdg` in the constructor (InvalidVaultUsdg) which this branch's constructor omits entirely. This branch's contract is strictly less defensive than the version already on main; if this branch's HookemonHook.sol were ever deployed instead of main's, a misconfigured or malicious USDG-like token returning no data would be treated as a successful fee transfer.

`requiredCandidatePaths` (the Phase 1 release-candidate source-closure whitelist) does not list `packages/contracts/src/HookemonHook.sol`, even though that file exists in `packages/contracts/src/` in this branch's own tree. Running `validateCandidateProductionSourceClosure({projectRoot: root, candidatePaths: requiredCandidatePaths})` against the real repo (confirmed by executing scripts/tests/phase1-release.test.mjs) throws 'production Solidity source set mismatch'. Rather than adding HookemonHook.sol to the whitelist, scripts/tests/phase1-release.test.mjs:168 was edited to assert.throws instead of assert.doesNotThrow -- i.e. the test suite was changed to accept a self-inconsistent release manifest instead of fixing it, mirroring the known main-branch pattern (PR #2's 'Verify deterministic state projection' failing because policy.json changed after gate receipts were recorded).

`activeContext` is a closure-scoped mutable variable read by the heartbeat's renewLease success path (`if (activeContext) Object.assign(activeContext.lease, lease)`) but the heartbeat's setTimeout callback and the main stage loop are not otherwise synchronized beyond `assertLease()` checks; if a stage's `commit`/`completeStage` call is slow enough to straddle a heartbeat renewal AND the store rejects the renewal (heartbeatError set), the next `assertLease()` inside that same in-flight call will throw only at its NEXT call site, not immediately -- a long-running stageDriver call with no internal assertLease() checkpoints could theoretically keep writing after the lease is fenced, until it returns control. The tests only exercise a stall at the start of `execute`, not mid-`commit`.

This 511-line file and main's 764-line file of the identical path/name test materially different contracts (this branch lacks TransferReturn.{Empty,Short,Excess} handling and the InvalidVaultUsdg constructor-revert test that main has); merging is a full content conflict requiring a decision about which HookemonHook.sol design wins, not just a line-level diff resolution.
